name: robo-fitting-room-vscode
description: 2D scene-layout editor for multi-robot industrial cells, hosted inside VS Code and backed by the robo-fitting-room REST server.

commands.title: robo-fitting-room: Open Swagger Docs in Browser

roboFittingRoom.serverUrl.description: Base URL of the running robo-fitting-room REST server.

roboFittingRoom.binaryPath.description: Path to the robo-fitting-room binary. Leave empty to use the binary bundled inside this (architecture-specific) extension; set an absolute path or a name on PATH to override with your own build.

roboFittingRoom.assetRoot.description: Asset root directory passed to `serve --asset-root`. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder. Leave empty to be prompted.

roboFittingRoom.serverHost.description: Host the managed server binds to (serve --host).

roboFittingRoom.serverPort.description: Port the managed server binds to (serve --port).

roboFittingRoom.webRoot.description: Optional --web-root passed to the managed server for live SPA editing. Usually left empty.
